when.quote: Before attempting retention, confirm the customer is eligible to close their account. Check these in order:

info.about: Any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address. These must match the customer's records.
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you please give me two of the following: your date of birth, email, phone number or address on file?

info.about: Which credit card account the customer wants to close. Match it to a credit_card_account_id from the customer's credit card accounts.
info.ask: Which credit card account would you like to close?

info.about: Why the customer wants to close. Map it to one of: annual_fee, not_using_card, found_better_card, unhappy_with_rewards, simplifying_finances, negative_experience, other.
info.ask: May I ask why you'd like to close this account?

info.about: For the found_better_card reason: which features of the other bank's card attracted the customer
info.ask: What features of the other card caught your interest?

info.about: Outstanding balance, open date and card type of the account
Whether any dispute on this account is still active or pending
Whether any replacement card order is not yet final
Whether this account has any closure reason records in the past year
Whether the customer accepts the tier retention offer and which form they choose (bonus points or statement credit), or declines it
info.ask: Before we close the account, I can offer you 5,000 bonus points or a $50 statement credit to stay with us. Would you like either of these?

steps.do: Look up the customer's record using the name, email or user id they gave

args.email: email given by the customer (or use get_user_information_by_name / get_user_information_by_id)

steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures.

steps.do: Ask for 2 of: date of birth, email, phone, address. Compare the answers with the record. Do not reveal any account details before the customer is verified.
steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures.

steps.do: Get the current time for the verification log and for date checks
steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures.
Verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures.

steps.do: Get the customer's credit card accounts. Identify the account to close and note its balance, open date and card type.
steps.quote: This can be found in the customer's account profile or by looking up their credit card accounts.

steps.do: Unlock get_user_dispute_history_7291, then call it. Look for any active or pending dispute (for example open or under_review) on this account.
steps.quote: To retrieve a user's credit card dispute history, use the get_user_dispute_history_7291 tool.

steps.do: Unlock get_pending_replacement_orders_5765, then call it. If any order is not final (pending or shipped), closure is blocked.
steps.quote: This is important to verify before processing account closures, as accounts with pending replacement orders cannot be closed until the replacement is delivered or the order is cancelled.

steps.do: Check the 4 conditions in order: no pending disputes, no pending replacement, account open at least 60 days (compare the open date with the current time), and $0.00 outstanding balance. If any condition fails, explain what must be resolved and stop. Make no retention offers and do not close.
steps.quote: If any requirement is not met, explain what must be resolved and do not proceed with retention offers.

steps.do: Unlock get_closure_reason_history_8293, then call it. Check whether this account has any closure reason records within the past year.
steps.quote: Use the get_closure_reason_history_8293 tool to determine whether this specific credit card account has any closure reason records within the past year.

steps.do: Tell the customer you will go ahead with their closure request. Skip the reason logging and all retention steps, and go to close_account.
steps.if: closure reason records exist for this account within the past year
steps.quote: If records are found within the past year, inform the customer you will proceed with their closure request and move to Step 6.

steps.do: Ask why the customer wants to close the account, unless they already said
steps.if: no closure reason records in the past year
steps.quote: Ask the customer why they want to close their account. Then log it using log_credit_card_closure_reason_4521.

steps.do: Unlock log_credit_card_closure_reason_4521, then call it with exactly these 3 arguments
steps.if: no closure reason records in the past year
steps.quote: Note: Only these three arguments are accepted. Do not add additional parameters.

steps.do: Ask which features of the other card attracted the customer. Compare those features with Rho-Bank's card documents. If a Rho-Bank card offers similar or better benefits, offer to help the customer apply for it instead of closing.
steps.quote: Found a better card: Ask what features attracted them. If Rho-Bank offers a card with similar or better benefits, offer to help them apply instead of closing the current account.

steps.do: The customer applies for the Rho-Bank card they chose
steps.if: customer accepts applying for a Rho-Bank card instead of closing
steps.quote: If Rho-Bank offers a card with similar or better benefits, offer to help them apply instead of closing the current account.

steps.do: Make exactly one retention offer for the card's tier. The Gold Rewards Card is premium tier: offer 5,000 bonus points or a $50 statement credit.
steps.if: customer still wants to close after their concern was addressed
steps.quote: If the customer still wants to close after addressing their concerns, make one retention offer based on their card tier:

steps.do: Unlock apply_statement_credit_8472, then call it to apply the retention statement credit. Do not close the account.
steps.if: customer accepts the statement credit option (premium tier: $50)
steps.quote: 'retention_offer': Credit offered to retain a customer

steps.do: Thank the customer without pressuring them. Unlock close_credit_card_account_7834, then call it to close the account.
steps.if: customer declines the retention offer, or closure history in the past year made retention ineligible (after skip_to_closure)
steps.quote: If the customer declines the retention offer (or was ineligible due to prior attempts), thank them for being a Rho-Bank customer and proceed with closure. Do not apply pressure.

steps.do: Tell the customer: a confirmation email and final statement will follow within several business days; unredeemed rewards can be redeemed for 45 days after the closure request and are then forfeited; an annual fee is fully refunded if the closure is within 37 days of the fee posting.
steps.quote: Inform the customer they have 45 days after submitting the closure request to redeem unredeemed rewards; after that, rewards are forfeited.

rules.rule: The outstanding balance must be $0.00 to close
rules.quote: Zero balance required: Your account must have an outstanding balance of $0.00 dollars.

rules.rule: No active or pending disputes on the account
rules.quote: Accounts with active or pending transaction disputes cannot be closed (pending disputes allowed: No).

rules.rule: The account must have been open for at least 60 days
rules.quote: Minimum account age: Your account must have been open for at least 60 days.

rules.rule: No replacement card order may be in a non-final state (pending or shipped)
rules.quote: If any order is in a non-final state (for example, pending or shipped), consider the account blocked from closure.

rules.rule: If any eligibility check fails, make no retention offer and do not close
rules.quote: If any requirement is not met, explain what must be resolved and do not proceed with retention offers.

rules.rule: Closure reason records for this account within the past year mean: skip retention and close directly
rules.quote: If records exist for this account within that time frame, skip retention offers and proceed directly to processing the closure.

rules.rule: The Gold Rewards Card is premium tier
rules.quote: Premium-tier and above (Gold Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Business Platinum Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card)

rules.rule: Retention offer by tier: entry 500 points or $5; mid 2,000 points or $20; premium and above 5,000 points or $50. Make only one offer.
rules.quote: Premium and above: Offer 5,000 bonus points or a $50 statement credit

rules.rule: log_credit_card_closure_reason_4521 accepts only credit_card_account_id, user_id and closure_reason
rules.quote: Note: Only these three arguments are accepted. Do not add additional parameters.

rules.rule: An annual fee is fully refunded only if the closure is within 37 days of the fee posting
rules.quote: Annual fee refund: If you close your account within 37 days of the annual fee posting, you are eligible for a full refund of that fee.

jobs.done_when: One of these is true: (a) the customer was told which eligibility requirement blocks closure and nothing was closed; (b) the customer accepted a Rho-Bank alternative card or the retention offer, and it was handled (statement credit applied via apply_statement_credit_8472); or (c) close_credit_card_account_7834 succeeded and the customer was told the post-closure information (45-day rewards window, 37-day annual fee refund, confirmation email and final statement).

documents.why: The retention protocol: eligibility order, closure-history check, reason logging, the found_better_card handling, tier retention offers and accepting the decision
The closure procedure, the close_credit_card_account_7834 tool and its arguments, and post-closure communication
Customer-facing closure eligibility rules, the 45-day rewards window and the 37-day annual fee refund
How to check pending replacement orders with get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 and how to read the statuses
The get_user_dispute_history_7291 tool, used for the pending-dispute check
The apply_statement_credit_8472 tool with reason 'retention_offer', used for the statement-credit retention option
The card tier mapping; it places the Gold Rewards Card in the premium tier
Gold Rewards Card features (2.5% cash back, $0 annual fee, requires a Rho-Bank+ subscription), used to compare against the competitor card
Possible Rho-Bank alternative: Platinum earns 10% cash back with a $200 annual fee (minimum credit score $750 per platinum_001)

open_questions: No document names a tool for crediting the 5,000 retention bonus points. Only the statement-credit option has a documented tool (apply_statement_credit_8472 with reason 'retention_offer'). If the customer picks points, the agent has no documented way to post them.

The retention protocol does not say whether the closure reason should still be logged when the closure-history check sends the agent straight to Step 6. It says 'move to Step 6', which implies Step 3 (logging) is skipped.
The account-records fields that hold the open date and outstanding balance are not named in the documents. The agent must read them from get_credit_card_accounts_by_user output.
For found_better_card, no document defines how to decide that a Rho-Bank card is 'similar or better'. The agent must compare the customer's stated features with the individual card documents.
